FIRST START: IMPORTANT INFO BELOW! PLEASE READ!
You're going to receive a dispatch from your HEMS company which will instruct you about your assigned mission. Missions are designed as follow...

You will starts from any location you like which will be set as home base. Then you'll to the accident area to rescue accident casualties. It is possible to either land and perform ground rescue, or, hoist down a crew member and stay in flight.
Patient may be (or may not) carried by the helicopter. In case you have to reach an hospital, select the hospital destination where the patient will be transported.
After the patient unloading, you may end the mission or return to home base. Home base may be the starting point or any other point on the map.
During return, you may receive a new dispatch and decide if ignore it or accept a new mission.
The following addons are required for correct mission operation
NOTE: the system is capable to automatically select national custom rescue vehicles if the relative addon package is installed. DOWNLOAD OF NATIONAL PACKAGES IS OPTIONAL.
FR vehicles by Batteroulio (see link on required addons here above)

NOTE: Even if the packages are independent between each other, make sure you install the 68PonyGT national packages BEFORE installing 68PonyGT Action pack HEMS Objects. If you experience issues with mission locks, re-install 68PonyGT Action pack HEMS again and let it overwrite old files. This is important as standard objects are included in every package and older ones may cause issues.

At startup, the briefing page will be proposed. A red message may ask you to connect the radio installed on the interseat console. The radio must be switched on, and, when requested, the 'PICK' button has to be pushed. Radio will remain connected until helicopter or radio power off.

Once connected, either wait for a dispatch (it will appear after a random delay), or push NEXT DISPATCH to immediately receive a dispatch. Location of the proposed dispatch may be reviewed on the map. Push ACCEPT DISPATCH to begin the mission.
By entering in SETTINGS the user may customize a series of settings including:
Modification marked with (P) are saved on PC while the others will affect only current mission and could be reset at next mission start up.
Non permanent settings can be customized by editing the mission JSON file.

By opening the file (preferred way HOC mission editor or a JSON editor (i.e. notepad++), but notepad is also allowed) and following the included instruction user may change a huge amount of settings. File changes are permanent.
